package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"sync/atomic"
	"time"

	"github.com/bahadrdsr/aspm/internal/app"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
)

type input struct {
	DatabaseURL, Schema, ApplicationName, BootstrapToken, AssessmentScope string
	StorageEndpoint, Bucket, Prefix, AccessKey, SecretKey                 string
	EncryptionKey                                                         []byte
}
type countedConn struct {
	net.Conn
	writes *atomic.Int32
}

type queryBudget struct{ count atomic.Int32 }

func (b *queryBudget) TraceQueryStart(ctx context.Context, _ *pgx.Conn, _ pgx.TraceQueryStartData) context.Context {
	if b.count.Add(1) > 400 {
		cancelled, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
		cancel()
		return cancelled
	}
	return ctx
}
func (*queryBudget) TraceQueryEnd(context.Context, *pgx.Conn, pgx.TraceQueryEndData) {}

func (c countedConn) Write(data []byte) (int, error) {
	if c.writes.Add(1) > 32 {
		return 0, errors.New("published intake write budget exceeded")
	}
	return c.Conn.Write(data)
}
func main() {
	if err := run(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "exact published V9 core fixture failed; private details withheld")
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
func run() error {
	var in input
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(io.LimitReader(os.Stdin, 64<<10))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if decoder.Decode(&in) != nil || !regexp.MustCompile(`^jira_items_[a-f0-9]{24}$`).MatchString(in.Schema) ||
		in.Prefix != "jira-work-items/"+strings.TrimPrefix(in.Schema, "jira_items_")+"/" || len(in.EncryptionKey) != 32 {
		return errors.New("unowned published fixture input")
	}
	db, err := url.Parse(in.DatabaseURL)
	if err != nil || db.Hostname() != "127.0.0.1" || db.Port() != "15432" || db.User == nil {
		return errors.New("unapproved PG boundary")
	}
	store, err := url.Parse(in.StorageEndpoint)
	if err != nil || store.Scheme != "http" || store.Hostname() != "127.0.0.1" || store.Port() != "18333" ||
		store.User != nil || store.RawQuery != "" || store.Fragment != "" {
		return errors.New("unapproved S3 boundary")
	}
	var writes atomic.Int32
	transport := http.DefaultTransport.(*http.Transport).Clone()
	transport.Proxy = nil
	transport.DialContext = func(ctx context.Context, network, address string) (net.Conn, error) {
		if address != store.Host {
			return nil, errors.New("published core permits only selected S3 intake")
		}
		conn, err := (&net.Dialer{Timeout: time.Second}).DialContext(ctx, network, address)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return countedConn{conn, &writes}, nil
	}
	http.DefaultTransport = transport
	defer transport.CloseIdleConnections()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 45*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	var queries queryBudget
	core, err := app.Open(ctx, app.Config{
		DatabaseURL: in.DatabaseURL, Schema: in.Schema, ApplicationName: in.ApplicationName,
		MaxConnections: 1, BootstrapToken: in.BootstrapToken, IntegrationEncryptionKey: in.EncryptionKey,
		ManualProcessing: true, PublicOrigin: "https://jira-work-items.synthetic.invalid",
		AssessmentScope: in.AssessmentScope, MaxUploadBytes: 64 << 10, SessionTTL: time.Hour, LogOutput: io.Discard,
		QueryTracer: &queries,
		Storage: app.StorageConfig{Endpoint: in.StorageEndpoint, Bucket: in.Bucket, Prefix: in.Prefix,
			AccessKey: in.AccessKey, SecretKey: in.SecretKey, Region: "us-east-1", Timeout: 4 * time.Second},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return errors.New("published app.Open failed")
	}
	defer core.Close()
	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		return errors.New("published HTTP listener unavailable")
	}
	server := &http.Server{Handler: core.Handler, ReadHeaderTimeout: 2 * time.Second}
	defer server.Close()
	go func() { _ = server.Serve(listener) }()
	encoder := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	outcome := func() error {
		return encoder.Encode(map[string]any{"ok": true, "queries": queries.count.Load(), "writes": writes.Load()})
	}
	if encoder.Encode(map[string]string{"address": "http://" + listener.Addr().String()}) != nil {
		return errors.New("published readiness pipe failed")
	}
	for count := 0; count < 4; count++ {
		var command struct{ Operation string }
		if decoder.Decode(&command) != nil {
			return errors.New("published bounded control pipe failed")
		}
		switch command.Operation {
		case "imports":
			if core.ProcessImports(ctx) != nil || outcome() != nil {
				return errors.New("published actual intake failed")
			}
		case "close":
			stop, done := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 2*time.Second)
			defer done()
			if server.Shutdown(stop) != nil || core.Close() != nil {
				return errors.New("published core shutdown failed")
			}
			return outcome()
		default:
			return errors.New("published control operation not allowed")
		}
	}
	return errors.New("published control budget exceeded")
}
